scripts.title: Inf Stamina
scripts.script:
local tame
repeat
    tame = filtergc("table", {Keys = {"state", "beginMount", "hasGrip", "update"}}, true)
    if not tame then task.wait(1) end
until tame
if tame.infiniteStamina then return end
local update = tame.update
tame.infiniteStamina = true
tame.update = function(...)
    local state = tame.state
    state.drain = 0
    state.gripMax = math.max(state.gripMax, state.required, 1)
    state.gripLeft = state.gripMax
    state.rideBudget = state.t + 1000000
    state.calmUntil = state.rideBudget
    return update(...)
end
-- [[ More scripts: t.me/arceusxcommunity ]]
